WOPHA x PEnumbra Discounted membership

In addition, we are offering an extra 5% off of online classes, totaling 20% off.

*Only valid for current WOPHA Members and for one annual discounted membership.

Penumbra Foundation, located in midtown Manhattan, is a resource, platform, and community for all contemporary image-makers. Our comprehensive facilities, which include a professional shooting studio, traditional B&W darkroom, historic processes darkroom, scanning and digital printing equipment, a risograph machine, and a private library, empower artists to express their vision. Penumbra's extensive educational programming enables artists to expand and hone their ideas and practice, while our Lecture Series, Exhibition Space, and Project Gallery–dedicated to emerging and mid-career women and non-binary artists, provide opportunities and spaces to have necessary conversations about urgent contemporary issues in the photographic arts.
For any questions, please reach out to Membership Coordinator gabrielle@penumbrafoundation.org
